import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, pandas.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pandas.DataFrame]:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    n = len(df)

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    amount_null = amount.isna()
    tax_null = tax.isna()

    # R1
    r1 = amount_null | (amount < 0)

    # R2
    r2 = tax_null | (tax < 0)

    # R3 (NULL-safe: skipped if amount or tax is NULL)
    both_present = (~amount_null) & (~tax_null)
    r3 = both_present & (tax > amount * 0.5)

    # R4
    r4 = due_date.isna()

    # R5
    ref_null = customer_ref.isna()
    ref_blank = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    non_null_mask = ~ref_null
    if non_null_mask.any():
        ref_blank.loc[non_null_mask] = (
            customer_ref[non_null_mask].astype(str).str.strip() == ""
        )
    r5 = ref_null | ref_blank

    codes = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "R1": pd.Series(["AMT_BAD" if v else "" for v in r1], index=df.index),
            "R2": pd.Series(["TAX_BAD" if v else "" for v in r2], index=df.index),
            "R3": pd.Series(["TAX_EXCESS" if v else "" for v in r3], index=df.index),
            "R4": pd.Series(["DUE_NULL" if v else "" for v in r4], index=df.index),
            "R5": pd.Series(["REF_EMPTY" if v else "" for v in r5], index=df.index),
        }
    )

    def join_codes(row):
        parts = [c for c in row if c != ""]
        return "|".join(parts)

    reason_codes = codes.apply(join_codes, axis=1)

    has_failure = r1 | r2 | r3 | r4 | r5

    invoices_clean = df.loc[~has_failure].copy()

    invoices_rejects = df.loc[has_failure].copy()
    invoices_rejects["reason_codes"] = reason_codes.loc[has_failure]

    return {
        "invoices_clean": invoices_clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "invoices_rejects": invoices_rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
